name: +1 Baddie Jumping ✨
desc:
Welcome to Baddie Jumping! 💎
Squat with baddie to soar higher into the sky!

How to Play:
🏋️‍♂️ Squat to build up your baddie strength
💸 Jump higher to earn money for new baddies
🚀 Reach different layers of the sky and show your ultimate skill

You literally jump even when you’re offline! 💤
